spans.text: Aaruni Shrivastava (ANALYST - DATA GOVERNANCE)
+ 82692 52814 / shrivastavaaaruni20@gmail.com /LinkedIn
Capital Market | Financial Modeling | Valuation | Data Governance | Private Equity C Venture Capital | Data Visualization
Summary
Business Data Analyst with 4+ years of experience in Capital Markets, Private Equity, Venture Capital, and Alternative Investments,
specializing in Data Governance, Business Analysis, and Investment Data Management. Experienced in business requirement gathering,
BRD/FRD preparation, metadata management, data quality, data validation, governance frameworks, and collaborating with data stewards,
data owners, and cross-functional stakeholders to improve data integrity and governance processes. Skilled in SQL, Power BI, stakeholder
management, and delivering data-driven insights across M&A, valuations, cap tables, transaction data, fixed income, derivatives, and
investment datasets to support investment and operational decision-making.
Professional Experience
BlackRock – Bengaluru, Karnataka
Analyst - Data Governance
Feb ‘23- Present
Developed a Private Markets Index covering 200+ high-value pre-IPO US companies, collaborating with the Strategy team to support
investment tracking and benchmarking.
Led end-to-end governance of M&A and private equity transactions, performing business requirement analysis, documenting
functional requirements, and validating data across portfolio companies, funds, valuations, and ownership structures.
Performed valuation analysis (DCF, trading comps, pre/post-money) using Excel, SQL, and Power BI on structured financial datasets.
Analyzed financial performance metrics (revenue, EBITDA, net debt, capex), delivering audit-ready insights.
Extracted and reconciled ownership, cap table, and transaction data from statutory filings (10-K/10-Q/8-K, AoA, shareholder registers, capital
records).
Standardized deal classification frameworks by analyzing business processes and stakeholder requirements, improving
consistency and comparability across investment datasets
Supported buy-side due dil
igence, company profiling, and sector research across Healthcare, Energy, FIG, TMT, and FMCG.
Delivered market intelligence and deal coverage across 800+ US s UK companies, enabling transaction-ready insights.
Reconciled datasets across Preqin Pro, Bloomberg, and regulatory filings, performing variance analysis using SQL and Excel to improve data
reliability.
Verified entity-level data via SEC/EDGAR, MCA, and Companies House filings.
Managed workflows via JIRA, collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve data gaps and improve processes.
Analyzed 300+ companies and G00+ fundraising rounds across funds, managers, and service providers.
Built MIS dashboards (Power BI, SQL) tracking KPIs, error trends, and SLA performance while preparing MI reports and executive
dashboards for stakeholders to support governance and operational decision-making.
Prepared business documentation including Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process
documentation, and functional specifications to support reporting enhancements and data governance initiatives.
Zigram – Gurugram, Haryana
Research Analyst
Nov ‘21- Nov ‘22
Executed AML/KYC workflows, including entity verification and ownership mapping across 1,500+ entities.
Identified and catalogued 2,000+ PEPs, Hate Groups, HNWIs, and related entities for risk and compliance assessment.
Built detailed profiles of companies and individuals using global regulatory filings and intelligence databases.
Improved data validation processes, reducing turnaround time and increasing workflow efficiency.
Delivered analytical reports and insights to support decision-making across high-priority projects.
Mentored 5+ associates, ensuring quality, consistency, and adherence to standards.
Developed Excel-based trackers and databases to streamline analysis and reporting.
Achievements
Earned a lateral promotion at BlackRock to the Data Governance C Quality team based on strong performance and impact.
Certificate of Appreciation- Recognized at Zigram as Best Performing Employee of the Quarter for exceptional research quality and team
contribution.
Part of the Recruitment Committee; streamlined resumes for BlackRock.
Skills
Data s Analytics: SQL, Alteryx, Advanced Excel, Prompt Engineering, AI Tools, MS PowerPoint, Data Interpretation
Visualisation s Reporting: Power BI, Data Visualisation C Reporting, Canva
Financial Skills: Financial Modeling, Real Estate Valuation, Deal Life Cycle
Governance s Platforms: Data Governance, Data Quality Management, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Metadata Management,
Governance Frameworks, Root cause Analysis (RCA), JIRA, Preqin Pro, SharePoint
Core Competencies:
Collaborative Teamwork C Leadership, Communication, Problem-Solving, Critical Thinking, Cross-Functional
Collaboration
Program & Project: Stakeholder Management, Management Information (MI) Reporting, Program Reporting, Project
Coordination, Risk Monitoring, Issue Tracking, Dependency Management, KPI Reporting, Executive Reporting.
Professional: Communication, Cross-functional Collaboration, Presentation Skills, Problem Solving, Critical Thinking
Certifications
Fundamentals of Alternative Investments (CAIA)
SQL (DataCamp)
Excel: Advanced Formulas and Functions (LinkedIn)
Excel Data Visualisation: Mastering 20+ Charts and Graphs (LinkedIn)
Prompt Engineering (DataCamp)
Education
MBA (Finance), Amity University – 7.6 CGPA
BCom (Hons), Prestige Institute of Management and Research – 75.3%
Mar ‘26
Sept ‘20
